region_scene_page.compact: This road catches the moment when bands, DJs, and labels blurred rock shows and dance floors through DFA-style grooves, electroclash pose, and blog-era club culture.
region_scene_page.standard: This road catches the moment when bands, DJs, and labels blurred rock shows and dance floors through DFA-style grooves, electroclash pose, and blog-era club culture. LCD Soundsystem's Losing My Edge, Le Tigre's Deceptacon, The Knife's Heartbeats, and Justice's D.A.N.C.E. give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: This road catches the moment when bands, DJs, and labels blurred rock shows and dance floors through DFA-style grooves, electroclash pose, and blog-era club culture. The sound is bodily but self-aware: punk edges, disco bass, synth bite, and scene irony. LCD Soundsystem's Losing My Edge, Le Tigre's Deceptacon, The Knife's Heartbeats, and Justice's D.A.N.C.E. give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
